PowerShell(Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match 'gemini|node' } | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, StartTime, @{Name='CPU\(s\)';Expression={$_.CPU}}, @{Name='RAM\(MB\)';Expression={[math]::Round\($_.WorkingSet64/1MB,1\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Get-WmiObject Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'gemini' } | Select-Object ProcessId, @{Name='CmdLine';Expression={$_.CommandLine.Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(120,$_.CommandLine.Length\)\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap)

PowerShell(Get-WmiObject Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'gemini' -and $_.CommandLine -notmatch 'extension|vscode' } | Select-Object ProcessId, @{Name='CmdLine';Expression={$_.CommandLine.Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(200,$_.CommandLine.Length\)\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap)
